claims.claim: Controller and worker collections use deterministic rule/count/digest identities with fail-closed conformance checks. The plugin references the unchanged canonical helper through _pytest_collection_identity, eliminating the accidental unknown hook.
Canonical phase and failure records retain exact nodeids, phases, details, fingerprints, profile and toolchain bindings independently of bounded display diagnostics.
Deterministic scale coverage models 8,192 long nodeids across twelve workers and checks complete observations and the final envelope against the unchanged 16 MiB canonical bound.
Cleanup failures remain subordinate to an established primary verification cause, with diagnostics limited to four entries of at most 1,024 characters each.
Unrecoverable cleanup without a prior failure raises RuntimeVerificationError; cleanup retries retain the existing finite elapsed-time bound.

The implementation remains confined to verification infrastructure and regression support. This repair changes only the plugin helper binding and focused registration coverage, preserving RepositoryLock, TASK-316 behavior, execution-profile selection and lifecycle authorities.
